issue_context.body:
### Summary

Cannot run make docker-compose to spin up devel environment if a symlink exists. This can be fixed by manually removing the symlink, but it is not a desirable work flow.

Set up:

Have an existing symlink (run `make symlink`)
Run `make docker-compose` 
The environment will not spin up successfully. Instead, you will see the following error:

```
Traceback:
```

review_comments:
It is a good practice to mark branches that are supposed to be unreachable. Modern type checkers, Python 3.11 and backports have a helper for this:
```suggestion
        os.remove(path)

    assert_never(path)
```
*(https://typing.readthedocs.io/en/latest/source/unreachable.html / https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html#typing.assert_never / https://stackoverflow.com/a/74535743/595220)*

This requires a fallback import from `typing_extensions` which our MyPy setup has pre-installed.

Per PEP 257, it's customary to use imperative mood in docstring title line sentences, for callables:
```suggestion
    """Remove the symlink/directory/file if it exists."""
```
